The '''Felucian ripper''', or '''Flying ripper''' was a dangerous creature native to the jungle [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. The ripper was a large predator that hunted in the jungle canopy, although it dwelt in shallow rivers and creeks. It had a wide body and large mouth filled with jagged, scissor-like teeth. It could hide in even the shallowest [[Water/Legends|waters]] and could leap out of the water to attack, provided that its movement ended back underwater. When hunting, rippers would fly low over the canopy, circling their prey, before swooping down to snap at the prey's head.<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Galen Marek]] encountered several such creatures during his [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|second visit]] to Felucia, when the balance of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on the planet had shifted to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Force Unleashed Novel" />
